body:
Thanks for your sandbox dhayab. I found the issue. I was managing a state inside the `<SearchContext />` called `searchIsActive`. The context also holds the searchClient. I wrapped the entire app with this SearchContext so any <InstantSearch /> component reacted to the state updates to `searchIsActive`.

Here's a reproduction sandbox: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/gh-6116-forked-d328gf

The problems lies in the following files:
* SearchContext (managing searchIsActive state)
* CustomSearchBox (useSearch hook and setting the searchIsActive state on events)

So when I interact with the header search box the status updates in the search page. The reason for wanting this state is for controlling a modal with a list of hits under the search box.

The workaround was to not have this state in the context but instead in the nearest common parent for any component that needs the state and prop drill it.
